kurals.tr: Vaannindru Ulakam Vazhangi Varudhalaal / Thaanamizhdham Endrunarar Paatru
kurals.m: By the continuance of rain the world is preserved in existence; it is therefore worthy to be called ambrosia

kurals.tr: Thuppaarkkuth Thuppaaya Thuppaakkith Thuppaarkkuth / Thuppaaya Thooum Mazhai
kurals.m: Rain produces good food, and is itself food

kurals.tr: Vinindru Poippin Virineer Viyanulakaththu / Ulnindru Utatrum Pasi
kurals.m: If the cloud, withholding rain, deceive (our hopes) hunger will long distress the sea-girt spacious world

kurals.tr: Erin Uzhaaar Uzhavar Puyalennum / Vaari Valangundrik Kaal
kurals.m: If the abundance of wealth imparting rain diminish, the labour of the plough must cease

kurals.tr: Ketuppadhooum Kettaarkkuch Chaarvaaimar Raange / Etuppadhooum Ellaam Mazhai
kurals.m: Rain by its absence ruins men; and by its existence restores them to fortune

kurals.tr: Visumpin Thuliveezhin Allaalmar Raange / Pasumpul Thalaikaanpu Aridhu
kurals.m: If no drop falls from the clouds, not even the green blade of grass will be seen

kurals.tr: Netungatalum Thanneermai Kundrum Thatindhezhili / Thaannalkaa Thaaki Vitin
kurals.m: Even the wealth of the wide sea will be diminished, if the cloud that has drawn (its waters) up gives them not back again (in rain)

kurals.tr: Sirappotu Poosanai Sellaadhu Vaanam / Varakkumel Vaanorkkum Eentu
kurals.m: If the heaven dry up, neither yearly festivals, nor daily worship will be offered in this world, to the celestials

kurals.tr: Thaanam Thavamirantum Thangaa Viyanulakam / Vaanam Vazhangaa Thenin
kurals.m: If rain fall not, penance and alms-deeds will not dwell within this spacious world

kurals.tr: Neerindru Amaiyaadhu Ulakenin Yaaryaarkkum / Vaanindru Amaiyaadhu Ozhukku
kurals.m: If it be said that the duties of life cannot be discharged by any person without water, so without rain there cannot be the flowing of water
